objective: Validate the broker-generated Elasticsearch Query DSL as the exact executed request while preserving fixed index scope, filter context, bounded projection, and execution provenance.
preconditions: a trusted typed broker request and authorization envelope exist
the deployed reviewed pack and field catalog are available
the fixed read-only Elasticsearch execution path is healthy
required_evidence: exact canonical Query DSL digest index scope endpoint and request-item digest
successful control shard timeout total-hit and projection metadata
result coverage truncation and evidence references bound to the executed request
positive_evidence: the exact executed Query DSL contains only broker-generated allowlisted filter clauses and trusted scope
admitted results satisfy the fixed pack projection tuple window and observable constraints
negative_evidence: a successful exact-total query returns zero matches for the complete authorized filters and time window
complete admitted results refute the scoped hypothesis without projection control or coverage gaps
escalation_pivots: select another reviewed pack or bounded window through typed broker parameters
compare the canonical Query DSL and execution digest with the independent validator
stop for operator review when controls mappings shards or execution provenance disagree

query_templates.purpose: Validate the exact executed broker-generated Query DSL and its bounded result projection without accepting model-supplied JSON index fields or clauses.

alternative_hypotheses: the broker request is valid but the deployed mapping or pack is stale
a complete exact-zero result is scoped absence rather than global absence
a bounded sample omits relevant matches
the executed request or returned projection violates the expected contract
stop_conditions: the exact request and admitted result projection independently validate
a control mapping shard timeout or provenance failure makes the result unusable
the next bounded reviewed query has low expected information value
a query budget or deadline is exhausted
confidence_limiters: missing exact execution digest or index scope
known_false_positive_patterns: routine administrative or monitoring activity matching exact filters
shared infrastructure represented by a correct event match
a syntactically and semantically correct query over incomplete retention
